about: NMDC Limited, together with its subsidiaries, explores for and produces iron ore in India and internationally. It operates through Iron Ore, Trading of HR Coil, and All Other Segments (Pellets, Other Mineral, Products, Services & Others). The company also explores for lithium, copper, rock phosphate, limestone, beach sand, coking and non-coking coal, magnesite, diamond, tungsten, nickel, gold, base metals, and rare earth metals.
